info.name: Get a list of all processes

params.name: filter_type
params.description: The type of filter to apply to the process list.

params.name: container_ids
params.description: A comma-separated list of container IDs to filter by. This parameter is only used when `filter_type` is set to `ByContainerOrProcess`.

params.name: process_ids
params.description: A comma-separated list of process IDs to filter by. This parameter is only used when `filter_type` is set to `ByContainerOrProcess`.

params.name: roles
params.description: A comma-separated list of process roles to filter by. This parameter is only used when `filter_type` is set to `Roles`. Valid roles include `Management`, `Drives`, `Compute`, and `Frontend`.

params.name: council
params.description: If true, query the cluster leadership members.

items.docs: Returns information about all running processes within the cluster. The list can be filtered by type, container, process ID, or role.

params.name: uid
params.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the process.

items.docs: Returns information about a specific running process, identified by its UID.
